pages.title: Omnilex Casing
pages.text: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing with a transfinite weave. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time. It feels like nothing at all.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine simulates the Tree and the Ocean, so its casing needed both. Arbor heartwood brought the Tree, crystallised law brought the rules, and the transfinite casing held them together.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnilex Engine.
